items.what: Booking details: first and last name, email, phone, the session and time picked, answers to the session's intake questions, whether the newsletter box was ticked, and the price, amount due, amount paid and order number
items.where: This website's database, in the bookings table (the Bookings screen)
items.kept: Until someone deletes it. The hourly check only changes a booking's status and never deletes it. The WordPress personal data tools export a person's bookings by email address. The eraser deletes unpaid bookings and keeps paid ones as payment records, with the name, email, phone and answers taken out, and deleting the plugin removes the whole table.
items.shared: Emailed to the site's own booking notice address (the notice address in Business info unless another is set), with the intake answers

items.what: Name, email and phone of each booking from the last 30 days and the next 400 days
items.where: The owner's private calendar feed, a secret address on this website
items.kept: Built fresh each time the feed is read; nothing extra is stored
items.shared: Whatever calendar app the owner adds the feed to

items.what: What the visitor typed in the booking form, when the form has to be sent back to fix a mistake
items.where: A temporary record in this website's database
items.when: only when the form is sent back with a problem, such as a missing field

items.what: Email, first name, the page the form was on, the exact words beside the newsletter box, and the session type
items.where: Handed to the Scout Newsletter plugin. This plugin keeps no separate copy beyond the booking itself.
items.kept: Not kept separately by this plugin
items.shared: Scout Newsletter, which sends it to the newsletter service set there
items.when: only when the visitor ticks the newsletter box and Scout Newsletter is on

items.what: Name, email, phone, the appointment time and the booking's code
items.where: WooCommerce's cart, checkout and order records on this website
items.kept: As long as WooCommerce keeps the order. This plugin never deletes orders.
items.when: only when WooCommerce is on and the session takes a payment online

notes: This plugin sets no cookies itself. When a session takes payment, WooCommerce sets its own cart and session cookies and keeps the order under its own rules.
